subject: Wire .nancy-pass into deploy.sh as a gate
description: record-nancy-pass.sh and _tools/deploy/.nancy-pass were created 2026-09-19 but deploy.sh does NOT check them, unlike .chris-pass which it enforces at Gate 1.5. The rule 'nothing deploys without Nancy approval' is older and unconditional but has never had an enforcement point, and that asymmetry cost a real round trip: Nancy gave a CONDITIONAL proceed, the conditions were fixed in a later commit, and Chris BLOCKED because no durable artifact told him whether she had seen it. Deliberately NOT wired in the same change that created the file - a new blocking check appearing unannounced in the deploy script is exactly the kind of surprise that gets bypassed with --force the first time it fires at an inconvenient moment. Wiring it needs its own decision about the escape hatch (a --skip-nancy with an audit log, mirroring --skip-chris) and about what happens to the many commits with no Nancy record at all.
